name: Baton 账本接近参考预算
Baton Turn 完成率相比前日下降

chartConfig.sqlTemplate: SELECT $__timeInterval(now()) AS ts, if(previous_rate = 0, NULL, current_rate / previous_rate) AS value FROM (SELECT countIf($__timeFilter(Timestamp) AND SpanAttributes['baton.turn.result'] = 'completed') / nullIf(countIf($__timeFilter(Timestamp)), 0) AS current_rate, countIf($__timeFilter(Timestamp + INTERVAL 1 DAY) AND SpanAttributes['baton.turn.result'] = 'completed') / nullIf(countIf($__timeFilter(Timestamp + INTERVAL 1 DAY)), 0) AS previous_rate FROM otel_traces WHERE SpanName = 'baton.turn' AND ($__timeFilter(Timestamp) OR $__timeFilter(Timestamp + INTERVAL 1 DAY)))
